summary: Immuneering Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce updated clinical trial data for atebimetinib in pancreatic cancer. The filing discloses a 17.3 month median overall survival (mOS) in a 55-patient Phase 2a intent-to-treat population versus an 8.5 month mOS standard of care, along with a 36% overall response rate and 84% weight stability. The company also outlines upcoming milestones, including a pivotal Phase 3 trial start in mid-2026 and topline data expected by mid-2028. No M&A or special-situation event is present; the filing is purely a voluntary clinical data update. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural changes.
